data.description:
## Description
**What**: Register a manifest-aware default validator with a03c-d55e's pluggable end-state-item-validator hook (contract_version=1). The validator returns {valid:false, severity:"warn", reason:<finding_type>} for orphan_intent / unresolved_ambiguity / cross_epic_reference, {valid:true} for clean entries, ignores pending_intent and lightweight_pending, and falls back to a03c's basic default when the manifest is absent. Update the completion-verifier output template to add a distinct Intent Allocation Findings section.
**Why**: Makes allocation hygiene observable at closure instead of silently passing through; this is where downstream sprint orchestrators see the findings.
**Scope**:
- IN: validator registration on the a03c hook; warn-severity mapping; manifest-absent fallback to a03c basic default; Intent Allocation Findings section in the completion-verifier output template.
- OUT: a03c's own hook implementation (external blocker); the migration backfill (sc-9).

## Done Definitions

- The manifest-aware validator is registered with a03c's end-state-item-validator hook and returns severity=warn with the matching reason for orphan_intent, unresolved_ambiguity, and cross_epic_reference findings ← Satisfies: sc-7
- The validator returns valid=true for clean entries and produces no finding for pending_intent or lightweight_pending entries ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When the manifest is absent for a legacy ticket, the validator falls back to a03c's basic present-and-schema-valid default ← Satisfies: sc-7
- The completion-verifier output template renders a distinct Intent Allocation Findings section that lists warn-severity findings separately from general output ← Satisfies: sc-7
- An integration test exercises the registered validator against a real a03c hook invocation in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no pre-existing worktrees, no global git config, no pre-set environment variables) and the test passes ← Satisfies: sc-7

## Considerations

- [External blocker] Depends on a03c-d55e providing the pluggable end-state-item-validator hook (contract_version=1, input {item_text, item_source_ticket_id, closure_timestamp}). This is a cross-epic depends_on at the epic level, not an in-epic story dependency; coordinate via the a03c blocker.
- [Observability] The Intent Allocation Findings section exists specifically so warn-severity findings are not buried in general verifier output.
- [Live-verified] Hook registration is runtime behavior verified against the real a03c hook, hence the environment-isolated integration test.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a completion verifier, I want a manifest-aware validator registered on a03c's end-state-item hook plus a distinct Intent Allocation Findings section, so that allocation warnings surface at closure.
